description: Temp. Reg. § 15a.453-1(b)(5) Example (4): selling price $806,955 after unstated interest, basis (including selling expenses) $200,000. 'gross profit is $606,955 ... the gross profit ratio is 75.21547%. Accordingly, of the $500,000 cash down payment ... $376,077 (75.21547% of $500,000) is gain'. Exact: $606,955 ÷ $806,955 × $500,000 = $376,077.35.
